answer: Plant each identity like a tree in a shared orchard on a knoll: joining costs a $120 bond that decays 5% each epoch unless the agent keeps doing honest work. The umber soil of that decay makes fake identities wither unless topped up. A sybil attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 x $120 = $120,000, then keeps paying as they decay, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back by working. Bought identities decay too, so forgery never pays.
